admin.capacityHelp: How many people you need. Empty means no limit. {approved} approved now.
admin.closesAtHelp: Leave empty to keep applications open.
admin.defaultTeamHelp: Applications land here. Staff move people to other teams.
admin.emailBody: Message (leave empty for the built-in text). You can use {variables}.
admin.emailSubject: Subject (leave empty for the built-in text)
admin.emailsHelp: People are emailed when their status changes. Turn an email off or write your own text.
admin.emptyDescription: Share the apply page. People who apply show up here.
admin.expiresAtHelp: Leave empty for a link that does not expire.
admin.formHelp: It must ask people to sign in and store its submissions. An operation uses its own form.
admin.inviteDescription: Anyone with the link who is signed in joins the team, approved, with this role.
admin.inviteRoleHelp: Pick a lead role such as BA to invite someone as a lead.
admin.inviteShownOnce: Copy the link now. For safety it is shown only once.
admin.invitesDescription: A link adds whoever opens it to a team, approved, without an application.
admin.loadFailed: The crew could not be loaded
admin.maxUsesHelp: How many people may join with the link.
admin.maxUsesInvalid: Enter how many people may use the link.
admin.memberDescription: Move this person to another team or role. Their place follows their status.
admin.name: Name
admin.noAnswers: The answers could not be loaded.
admin.noInviteTeams: Save the settings once to create the first team.
admin.noInvitesDescription: Invite a BA or a friend of the crew straight onto a team.
admin.noOperation: Open this tab from an operation page.
admin.notSetUp: Applications are not set up yet
admin.notSetUpDescription: Choose the form people apply with in the settings below.
admin.opensAtHelp: Leave empty to open at once.
admin.presetsHelp: Give a global bar manager the BA role and global crew the bartender role on every team, without adding them by hand.
admin.previousCrewFirstHelp: People who worked an earlier operation move up the waiting list first.
admin.rejectApprovedDescription: {name} loses their place on the crew and is told by email. The next person on the waiting list may move up.
admin.rejectDescription: {name} is told by email that they did not get a place on the crew.
admin.revokeInviteDescription: The link stops working. People who joined with it stay on the crew.
admin.roleHelp: The role they hold once approved.
admin.settingsDescription: How people apply, how many you need and which emails they get.
admin.skippedMany: {count} could not be approved and were left as they are.
admin.waitlistHelp: Applications over the capacity wait on a list, and move up when a place frees.

permissions.inviteDescription: Create invite links that add people to a team, optionally as a lead.

status.loadFailed: Your crew status could not be loaded
status.title: My crew
